name: Hate Spike
text: Kill an ally to deal 3 to a unit and if Evelynn started in your deck, summon a random Husk.

name: Eternal Dancers
text: Keywords: Hallowed. Attack: Revive an attacking Ephemeral copy of the strongest dead ally other than Eternal Dancers with my power or less.

name: Skulking String-Puller
text: Attack: Grow other attacking allies' Power to mine this round.

name: The Darkin Ballista
text: Keywords: Equipment. You may spend 8 mana to play me as Naganeka of Zuretta.

name: Xolaani the Bloodweaver
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. I have +2|+2 for each ally that died with its power increased. Empowered 16: Transform me into Xolaani, Aspect's Bane.

name: Draconic Bands
text: Keywords: Equipment, Fury. My bearer is a Dragon.

name: Lawkeeper
text: Play: Stun enemies with less Power than me.

name: Ornn
text: Keywords: Tough. Play: Equip me with an exact copy of an ally's equipment or the strongest equipment from hand. Attack: Forge me twice. Level up: An ally has struck for 8+ damage in one strike.

name: Warden of the Tribes
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. When I'm summoned, grant allies +1|+1 for each different subtype you’ve summoned this game.

name: Winter's Touch
text: Get an empty mana gem. Enlightened: I cost 1. Draw 1.

name: Wild Mysticism
text: Get an empty mana gem. Summon a Feral Mystic.

name: Sharesies
text: Give an ally with an attachment the stats and keywords of its attachment this round and move the attachment to another ally.

name: Origami Slicer
text: Keywords: Equipment. Give me +1|+0 for each of your traps or boons that was activated this round.

name: Skrappy's Partsapalooza
text: Keywords: Landmark. When I'm discarded, summon me. When you summon a Mecha Yordle, grant it a random keyword.

name: Realm's Caretaker
text: Each round, the first time one of your traps or boons activate, give allies +1|+1 and Impact this round.

name: Living Library
text: Keywords: Elusive. When I'm summoned, if one of your traps or boons has activated this round, draw 1.

name: Master Yi
text: Keywords: Quick Attack, Flow. Round Start: Reduce the cost of a spell in your hand by 1 and Flow: Grant all allied Master Yis Everywhere +2|+0. Level up: Allied Master Yis have dealt 12+ damage.

name: Hexbliterator
text: Deal 6 to a unit. If it would die, Obliterate it instead.

name: Encore
text: Create a random new 2 cost spell in hand, reduce it's cost by 2 and grant it Fleeting.

name: Seraphine
text: When I'm summoned, create a random new 2 cost spell in hand. Level up: You've played 9+ new spells.

name: Back Alley Bar
text: Keywords: Landmark, Missing Translation. When I'm summoned, summon a Back Alley Barkeep. Your new cards cost 1 less.

name: High Note
text: Deal 2 to a unit. If you've played 6+ other new spells this game, deal 1 to another unit.

name: Inspired Plans
text: Keywords: Equipment. Attack: Create a new 2 cost spell in hand and grant it Fleeting.

name: Ambitious Cultist
text: Once you've Equipped an ally this game, create in hand a new spell that costs 2 and set its cost to 0 this round.

name: The Zaun Diva
text: Play: Deal 1 to all enemies. If you've played 6+ new spells this game, deal 3 instead.

name: Acoustician
text: Strike: Create a random new 2 cost spell in hand.

name: Crowd Pleaser
text: Keywords: Flow. Give an ally +2|+0 and Quick Attack this round. Flow: Create a new 2 cost spell in hand.

name: The Darkin Harpoon
text: Keywords: Equipment, Fearsome. Attack: Draw 1 at next Round Start and grant it Fleeting. You may spend 9 mana to play me as Ibaaros.

name: Test of Spirit
text: Give an enemy Vulnerable this round. If it dies this round, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.

name: Loaded Vessel
text: Deal 2 to a unit. Draw 1 at the next Round Start for each damage dealt and grant them Fleeting.

name: The Altar of Blood
text: Keywords: Landmark. When you slay a unit, reduce the cost of the next Darkin Unit you play by 1.

name: Curse of the Tomb
text: Predict. Give a unit "I take double damage and if I would die, Obliterate me instead" this round.

name: Void Gate
text: Keywords: Landmark. When you summon an ally or an ally dies, grant each of its positive keywords to 3 allies in your deck.

name: Rockbear Shepherd
text: When you summon another ally, advance your highest Countdown landmark 1 round. When I'm summoned, summon a Hibernating Rockbear.

name: Priestess Of Desert Light
text: Round Start: Deal 4 to me. Draw a champion and grant it +2|+2. If your deck started with 6+ different champions, summon it instead.

name: The Darkin Bloodletters
text: Keywords: Equipment. Last Breath: If my bearer is not a Darkinthrall, summon a Darkinthrall. You may spend 6 mana and kill an ally to play me as Xolaani.

name: The Darkin Aegis
text: Keywords: Equipment, Tough. You may spend 5 mana to play me as Joraal.

name: Icathian Myths
text: Create an Icathian Mirage in hand that costs 0 this round, or create a Golden Spatula in hand.

name: Fish Fight
text: An ally and an enemy strike each other, or an Equipped ally strikes an enemy, then is unequipped.

name: The Darkin Halberd
text: Keywords: Equipment. To play me, kill an ally. You may spend 10 mana to play me as Taarosh.

name: Wraith of Echoes
text: Round End: For each ally that died this round, grant all allied copies of it everywhere +1|+1.

name: Quietus
text: Kill a unit with total Power and Health of 4 or less, or destroy a unit's equipment.

name: Blades of the Fallen
text: Give an ally "Last Breath: Summon a Icathian Mirage with my equipment" this round.

name: Stylish Shot
text: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus. The next time an ally strikes the Nexus this round, create a Stylish Shot in hand.

name: Samira
text: Keywords: Quick Attack, Plunder. Plunder or strike: Create a Flair in hand if you don't already have one. Level up: I've seen you play 6 cards. Resets when you start a round with the attack token.

name: Perfidious Promoter
text: When you refill mana, create a Fleeting random follower in hand you can exactly afford.

name: Barbed Chain
text: Keywords: Plunder. Plunder: I cost 2 less. Draw 2 at the next Round Start and grant them Fleeting.

name: Tag Out!
text: Recall an ally and create a Coin in hand, or spend 5 mana to Recall an enemy and create a Coin in hand.

name: Master Bingwen, the Sieve
text: Keywords: Elusive. Play: The next time you play a unit this round, summon an exact Ephemeral copy of it.

name: Beguiling Cobra
text: Each round, the first time you play another follower, summon an exact copy of it. If your board is full, grant its stats and keywords to me instead.

name: Secret Keeper
text: When I'm summoned, create at the bottom of your deck two random level 2 champions that aren't in your hand, deck, or play.

name: Frostcoat Cub
text: Spend 6 mana to play me as Frostcoat Mother instead.

name: Soul Harvest
text: Kill a follower with 3 or less Power, or spend 3 mana to kill a champion with 3 or less Power.

name: Sacrificial Scholar
text: Keywords: Last Breath. Last Breath: Create in hand copies of the first 3 spells you played on me.

name: Condense
text: Pick a follower. Create a 1 cost copy of it in hand and set its stats to 1|1.

name: Anura & Froop
text: Keywords: Missing Translation. Allies that have a different subtype than other allies in play cost 1 less.

name: Bonehide Tri-tail
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+1 for each different subtype other allies have.

name: Deck Hunter
text: Play: Manifest a follower that has a different subtype than allies in play.

name: Blimp-Pack Poacher
text: Ambush 3 When I transform from Blimp-Pack Poacher's Ambush, the next time I block or am blocked this round, Capture my enemy.

name: Ingvar the Younger
text: Play: Pick an ally. Grant it and all other allies that share a subtype with it +1|+1 or Manifest a follower that shares a subtype with it.

name: Glacial Saurian
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. When I'm summoned, grant the top 3 units in your deck +1|+1. If an ally has a different subtype than me, draw 1 of those units.

name: Tufted Webspinner
text: Keywords: Fearsome. Play: If an ally has a different subtype than me, give an enemy -2|-0 this round.

name: Ferocious Fluffs
text: Keywords: Impact. When I'm summoned, grant other allies that have subtypes +1|+1 and Impact.

name: Crested Lionhawk
text: Keywords: Tough. Play: If an ally has a different subtype than me, Manifest a Demacian spell.

name: Mageseeker Junior
text: Keywords: Missing Translation. Spells that cost less than 3 cost 3 instead.

name: Shackled Ghasts
text: Keywords: Last Breath. Last Breath: The next time you revive an ally, create a copy of me in hand.

name: Sefirsa, Scourge of the Deep
text: Keywords: Deep. When you spend mana to play another unit, create a random card in hand of equal cost. It costs 0 and is Fleeting.

name: Prototype Porobot
text: Keywords: Elusive, Attune, Last Breath. Last Breath: Grant a random 6+ cost spell in hand "When I'm played, summon a Prototype Porobot."

name: Janna
text: Play: Updraft 2 to draw 2 at the next Round Start. Each round, the first 3 times you draw a card, reduce its cost by 1 this round. Level up: I've seen you play 8 cost reduced cards.

name: Howling Gale
text: Deal 2 to a unit. Increase my damage by 1 for each other card you've played this round, up to 3 times.

name: Exalted Cloudwinder
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. If you've drawn 3+ cards this round, I cost 2 less. When I'm summoned, draw 2 at the next Round Start.

name: Bladebound Berserker
text: When you play a Slow spell that targets a single ally, copy it onto me.

name: Volibear
text: Play: Play Relentless Storm 3 times. Each one targets a different random enemy or the enemy Nexus if none. Level up: Round End: You've dealt 50+ damage.

name: Clash of Giants
text: Summon 2 random Titanic followers. I cost 1 less for each Elemental spell or Skill you've played this game (max 10).

name: Handy Harness
text: Keywords: Equipment. I have +1|+0 for each different subtype you've summoned this game.

name: Armed Acquisitioner
text: Play: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.

name: Horned Swarmcaller
text: Keywords: Fury. Play: Grant two enemies -1|-0 and disable their positive keywords.
